rules.ties: Chapter: fewer mistakes (Credit: retained budget), then seeded draw. Hoarder: more completed objectives. Trailblazer: higher total score. Hero: more distinct recipients. Intelligence: more completed objectives. Discovery: more completed objectives. Trader: more consumed supplied items. Survivor: more completed objectives. Exact ties use a recorded seeded draw.
rules.fallback: No qualifying candidate: leave prize unawarded. Never award an employee twice.

thresholds.trader: one recipient consumes a supplied item in a required task

rules.fiction: Insurance, budgets, and credit outcomes are fictional game models. Trading does not improve real credit.
